title: Organization structure
intro: Departments, cost centers and position holders of the organization. Every change is recorded in the history. Moving a department and changing the holder of a position the DOA refers to must be approved by the authority before it takes effect.
forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, contact your organization admin.

departments.title: Departments
departments.listTitle: Department tree ({count, plural, one {# department} other {# departments}})
departments.moveHint: Moving a department under another one changes who approves its documents, so it must be approved by the authority before it takes effect.
departments.costCenters: {count, plural, =0 {No cost centers} one {# cost center} other {# cost centers}}
departments.move: Propose a move under another department
departments.codeHint: Letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, up to 40, e.g. QA or CON-2
departments.createIntro: The new department sits under the one you choose. Moving it later is proposed as an authority change.

costCenters.title: Cost centers
costCenters.empty: No cost centers yet. Add the first one with the Add a cost center form.
costCenters.codeHint: Letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, up to 40, e.g. CC-QA
costCenters.createIntro: A cost center belongs to one department and cannot move. If you chose the wrong department, switch it off and add a new one.
costCenters.deactivated: {code} switched off. You can switch it on again from this list.

positions.title: Positions and holders
positions.intro: A position the DOA refers to, or that open approval tasks came from, changes holders only after the authority approves. Other positions are assigned or ended at once.
positions.empty: The organization has no positions yet. Positions come from the organization’s initial data; contact the BCS team.
positions.authority: The DOA refers to this position: its holder changes only after the authority approves.
positions.openTasksOnly: Open approval tasks came from this position: its holder changes only after the authority approves.
positions.noAuthority: The DOA does not refer to this position: assign or end its holder at once.
positions.openTasks: {count, plural, one {# open approval task} other {# open approval tasks}} from this position
positions.proposeReplace: Propose a new holder instead of {name}
positions.replaceHint: If someone holds it already, their term ends at once when the new holder is assigned.
positions.endConfirmText: {name} stops holding this position at once. The history of the term stays.

warnings.POSITION_VACANT: {position} of {department} becomes vacant when the change takes effect. Documents this position approves go to the same position in a department higher up; if there is none, no approver is found until a new holder is appointed.
warnings.DOA_LINT_VACANT_POSITION: Rule {rule}: nobody holds the position it names on the effective date. Documents under this rule find no approver until someone is appointed.
warnings.DOA_LINT_MEMBER_APPROVER: Rule {rule} names a person as approver. If they move or leave, a new DOA version is needed.

errors.CODE: Use letters, digits, hyphens or underscores, up to 40
errors.CODE_EXISTS: This code is in use. Choose another one.
errors.NAME: Enter the name (Thai)
errors.PARENT: Choose the department it sits under
errors.NO_CHANGE: Nothing changed. Edit something before saving.
errors.VACANT: Nobody holds this position any more. Reload the page to see the latest.
errors.ORG_POSITION: An organization-wide position belongs to the root department only
errors.USE_ORG_AUTHORITY_CHANGE: The DOA refers to this position or move. Propose it on the Authority changes page for the authority to approve.
errors.EFFECTIVE_IN_PAST: The effective time cannot be in the past. Choose now or later.
errors.SOD_VIOLATION: You cannot propose a change you gain from ({rule}). Ask another organization admin to propose it.
errors.CYCLE: A department cannot move under itself or a department below it
errors.REPARENT_WAITING: Another department move is waiting for approval or its effective time. One move at a time.
errors.GOVERNANCE_UNRESOLVABLE: After this change nobody could approve DOA or authority changes ({rules}). Name a new holder in the same request.
errors.INVALID_PERIOD: The end of the acting period must be after its start
errors.SELF_DELEGATION: The delegator and the acting person must be different people
errors.NOTHING_TO_DELEGATE: The delegator holds no position with approval authority for this whole period, so there is nothing to act for
errors.DELEGATE_NOT_ACTIVE: The acting person must be an active member
errors.OVERLAPPING_DELEGATION: The delegator already has someone acting for an overlapping period
errors.REASON: Enter a reason of at least 3 characters
errors.EFFECTIVE: Enter the effective date and time
errors.PERIOD: Enter the start and end of the acting period
errors.AMOUNT: Enter the limit as a number with at most 2 decimals, e.g. 50000.00
errors.INPUT: Some information is missing or not valid. Check the fields and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item was not found. Reload the page and try again.
errors.STATE: The item has changed in the meantime. Reload the page and try again.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Sign in again and repeat this action.
errors.CONFLICT: This was already sent with different details. Reload the page and try again.
errors.BUSY: Another change of the organization is being saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong (reference {requestId}). Try again; if it still fails, give this reference to the BCS team.
errors.NO_APPROVER: No approver could be found under the DOA. Check that a DOA is in effect and that the approving positions have holders.
errors.REASON_TOO_LONG: The reason is longer than {max} characters. Shorten it and try again.
errors.NO_ANSWER: No answer came back from the system. Check your internet connection and press the button again; the same request will not run twice.

authority.title: Authority changes
authority.intro: Appoint or end holders of positions the DOA refers to, move departments, set someone to act for another person, and reset the identity of an approver. Every change must be approved by the authority under the DOA before it takes effect, and the proposer can never approve it.
authority.forbidden: This page is for organization admins. If you need it, contact your organization admin.
authority.empty: No authority changes yet. To appoint or end a holder of a position the DOA refers to, move a department or set someone to act for another person, start with Propose an authority change.
authority.inProgressEmpty: No change is waiting for approval or its effective time
authority.historyEmpty: No change has taken effect or been rejected yet

kinds.DELEGATION_ON_BEHALF: Set someone to act for another person

kindHints.POSITION_ASSIGN: A member holds a position the DOA refers to; the former holder’s term ends and open tasks move to the new holder when it takes effect.
kindHints.POSITION_END: End a holder’s term, with a replacement or leaving the position vacant.
kindHints.DEPARTMENT_REPARENT: Move a department under another one; who approves its documents follows the new tree.
kindHints.DELEGATION_ON_BEHALF: Name someone to act for an absent approver when they cannot set it themselves.
kindHints.IDENTITY_RESET: Reset the two-step sign-in of someone the DOA refers to or who has open approval tasks, e.g. after losing a phone.

summary.POSITION_END: End the holder of {position} of {department}, with no replacement
summary.POSITION_END_REPLACED: End the holder of {position} of {department}; {replacement} holds it instead
summary.unreadableKind: {kind}: the details of this item cannot be read

authority.effectiveOnApproval: As soon as it is approved
authority.impactTasks: {count, plural, one {# open task moves} other {# open tasks move}}
authority.initialPackage: the organization’s initial package (approved by the contract signatory)

new.title: Propose an authority change
new.intro: Before sending, you see the impact — who gains or loses authority and the open tasks that move — and then it goes to the authority under the DOA for approval.

fields.noReplacement: No replacement: the position becomes vacant
fields.replacementHint: Without a replacement you will be asked to confirm that the position becomes vacant.
fields.documentTypes: Document types to act for (none chosen = all, including types added later)
fields.maxAmount: Highest amount to act for (baht, optional)
fields.identityMember: Member whose two-step sign-in is reset
fields.identityHint: Once approved, the member is signed out on every device and sets up an authenticator app again.
fields.identityEffective: Reset as soon as the authority approves
fields.delegationEffective: The acting arrangement is recorded as soon as the authority approves and starts at its start time.
fields.effectiveOnApproval: As soon as it is approved
fields.effectiveAt: At a date and time (Thai time)
fields.reason: Reason (kept in the history and shown to the approver)
fields.timeHint: Pick the date and time in Thai time

new.effectiveOnApproval: Takes effect as soon as the authority approves
new.effectiveAtTime: Takes effect {time} (if approved later, as soon as it is approved)
new.tasksMove: {count, plural, one {# task moves} other {# tasks move}} to the new holder when the change takes effect
new.tasksNone: No open task needs to move
new.approverLine: Goes to {names} for approval under {ref}. The approver confirms their identity again before approving.
new.warningsTitle: Warnings to confirm one by one
new.warningsHint: Tick each one to confirm you understand its effect
new.sent: Sent for approval. Waiting for {name} to approve.
new.sentNoName: Sent for approval. Waiting for the authority to approve.
new.tasksStay: {count, plural, one {# task stays} other {# tasks stay}} with {names} because there is no new holder. The organization admins are told when the change takes effect.
new.tasksStayHeld: {count, plural, one {# open task of this position stays} other {# open tasks of this position stay}} with whoever holds them now, because there is no new holder. The organization admins are told when the change takes effect.
